highlights: UGREEN 90671 2.4G Wireless Mouse Ergonomic Silent Mouse with Wireless Receiver

The 2.4G wireless mouse is a product with a perfectly thought-out design that provides convenience and comfort. Ergonomically contoured shape and noiseless clicking with 99% noise reduction allow you to use it for days without disturbing others.

The UGREEN mouse operates on a 2.4G wireless connection, ensuring a stable connection and no disconnections, as well as smooth control. With a wireless connection range of up to 10 meters, you can freely use the device in larger areas.

The product allows you to adjust 4 DPI levels, so you can adjust the precision of the mouse movement to your needs and preferences. When drawing with precision, a DPI of 800/1200 will work, while for office work - 1600 DPI. And for a 2K screen, use 2400 DPI. What's more, the mouse is suitable for a variety of surfaces, including glass, fabric, paper and wood.

The UGREEN wireless mouse weighs just 85 grams, allowing for comfortable use in a variety of places. It is equipped with a large battery that allows the device to work for up to 18 months. What's more, it will automatically go to sleep after 10 minutes of inactivity, saving energy.

The device is compatible with various operating systems, including Windows, Mac OS, Linux, Android, HarmonyOS and iPad iOS, ensuring universal compatibility. With UGREEN, nothing will limit you anymore!
